description: Cut an ad, landing page, signup flow or any single screen down until a stranger gets it in 3 seconds: one picture, at most 15 words, one button. Use when a page, ad or funnel is wordy, unclear, gets views but no clicks, or has no obvious next click, for website redesign, landing page or ad ideas, when someone asks to "simplify this page", "make it simpler" or "make it shorter", and whenever someone asks to "caveman" something. Not for long persuasive copy written from scratch.
